notes.title: Demo Update: Roguekile Simple Progression
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
We’re excited to share an update for the [i]Canvas Infernum[/i] demo, introducing a first step into simple roguelike progression and many bug fixes.[/p][p]We want to thank all the players who have taken the time to give us feedback so far, and let you know that from now on [b]we’ll be active on the Steam Community Hub [/b] posting news and updates about the game’s development. ːmonstertraininfernoː[/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently working hard on new features to boost replayability and fun, such as new Pacts, a Midgame Shop that sells special usable itens, and a Sandbox Mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to reach out anytime and let us know what you would like to see next, and we hope you enjoy the new update! Please keep in mind we’re a small team working on this project alongside our day jobs, but we’re doing our best to dedicate as much time as we can to the game.[/p]
